scope: Amazon Reviews matched experiments; model family remains constrained by original prompts
global_budget_change: none; reservation and all failed attempts are charged within the existing cap
local_promotion: compare against current basin incumbent; preserve monotone global validation history
trial_cap: ceil(max(min_trial_seconds + 5, p75(last 32 positive measured trial costs) * 1.25 + 5))
retune_group_size: largest integer in 1..4 whose jump plus four retune groups fit the protected envelope
acceptance: retune best validation score strictly exceeds pre-jump global incumbent
incomplete_window: restore old incumbent unless already exceeded; no delayed alpha/beta credit
comparison: same data, evaluator, LLM and total GPU budget for jump on/off; exploration trigger is logged explicitly
